action: Side view of a full-width badminton court. Left player stands at the far left end, facing +x; right player at the far right end, facing −x; a tall net at x=0 divides the court. Beat 1: left player strikes the shuttle at the left end. Beat 2: shuttle arcs high over the net, traveling +x across the long empty middle while both players recover at their ends. Beat 3: right player strikes the shuttle at the right end. Beat 4: shuttle arcs high back over the net traveling −x while both recover. Beat 5: left player meets the returning shuttle with the racket again at the left end — a completed two-way rally. Only the shuttle and the players' limbs move; feet stay planted at their court ends, net and ground stay put.
layout_notes: Ground is a straight horizontal L near y=-0.7 spanning nearly full width; net is one vertical anchored L at x=0, chest/head height. Left player's feet planted near x=-0.85, facing +x; right player's feet planted near x=+0.85, facing −x. Shuttle is smaller than a head and travels a long high arc: launch near x=-0.7, apex high over the net at x=0, descend to right racket near x=+0.7, then mirrored arc back to the left racket. Keep the middle of the court empty so the long flight reads. Rackets: straight L handle from the hand plus a closed oval head (Q loop + Z), oval smaller than a head. +x right, +y up.

keys.name: left_contact_out
keys.beat: left player hits the shuttle outbound
keys.notes: Left player in a lunging hit pose at the left end: head looks +x, torso leans +x, racket arm extended up and +x so the racket head meets the shuttle just off the left shoulder; free arm trails −x; front leg bent toward +x, back leg extended −x, feet planted. Right player upright at the far right end, head looking −x watching, racket held low ready. Shuttle touching the left racket head.

keys.name: shuttle_over_net_out
keys.beat: shuttle flies high over the net going +x
keys.notes: Shuttle at its apex high above the net at mid-court, nose pointing +x and slightly down along its flight. Left player recovered to an upright ready stance at the left end: head looks +x, torso near vertical, racket held chest-high aiming +x. Right player crouched into a low ready stance at the right end: head looks −x and up at the shuttle, torso leaning −x, racket arm cocked back and up aiming −x, feet planted.

keys.name: right_contact_return
keys.notes: Right player in a lunging hit pose at the right end: head looks −x, torso leans −x, racket arm extended up and −x so the racket head meets the shuttle just off the right shoulder; free arm trails +x; front leg bent toward −x, back leg extended +x, feet planted. Left player upright at the far left end, head looking +x watching, racket held low ready. Shuttle touching the right racket head.

keys.name: shuttle_over_net_back
keys.beat: shuttle flies high back over the net going −x
keys.notes: Shuttle at its apex high above the net at mid-court, nose pointing −x and slightly down along its flight. Right player recovered to an upright ready stance at the right end: head looks −x, torso near vertical, racket held chest-high aiming −x. Left player crouched into a low ready stance at the left end: head looks +x and up at the incoming shuttle, torso leaning +x, racket arm cocked back and up aiming +x, feet planted.

keys.name: left_contact_return
keys.beat: left player meets the returning shuttle — rally complete
keys.notes: Left player in a finishing hit pose at the left end: head looks +x, torso leans +x, racket arm extended up and +x with the racket head meeting the returning shuttle just off the left shoulder; free arm trails −x; front leg bent toward +x, back leg extended −x, feet planted. Right player upright at the far right end, head looking −x watching, racket held low ready. Shuttle touching the left racket head — the two-way rally is complete.

gaps.why: shuttle launches fast off the racket then floats up into its long arc toward the net
shuttle descends smoothly along the long arc to the right racket while players settle into their poses
return launches fast off the right racket then floats up into the mirrored arc back over the net
shuttle descends along the final arc and decelerates into the left racket contact that completes the rally
